description: Read-only replay of daily No Meal Left Behind grants from game 1.24. Jade Emporium grants one level and the bundle grants two levels to one lowest eligible meal. Ties use the highest meal index. Awards stop at level 150 or the account meal cap. All account inputs come from native getters and saved meal levels; this extraction does not execute a daily reset or change game state.
target: Cooking No Meal Left Behind daily meal count, level gain, sources and next target

extractions.description: Replay the captured DailyResetTick 1.24 selection and award rules without calling the reset. Source: docs/game-snippets/cooking/DailyResetTick.1.24.js and ../IdleonWikiBot/codefiles/idleon1.24.txt:322671-322704. Native meal levels, maximum meal level and both ownership sources establish pairing with the retained real save. A selected meal at level 150 or higher has no awarding target. Configured count and gain remain enabled when no target remains.
